suggestions.quote: automated restart-based mitigation resolved 90% of supported-scope incidents within 30 minutes of detection
suggestions.reason: The surrounding wording retains the supported scope, mitigation mechanism and detection-based timing. However, 'resolved' can suggest final incident closure, whereas N1 specifically measures mitigation and excludes subsequent human handling. This is a precision suggestion, not an established change to the metric's scope.
suggestions.suggested_correction: Use 'automated restart-based recovery mitigated 90% of supported-scope incidents within 30 minutes of detection'. Retain escalation wording and do not invent incident categories.

omission_assessment.reason: The draft retains queue reliability, authentication operations, diagnostics, technical leadership and hands-on development.
